about:
Spotted Owl Timber, Inc. operates a sawmill in Santa Fe, New Mexico. The company was founded in 1991 by David Lindsey, a third-generation sawmill operator born and raised in New Mexico’s logging industry. Lindsey launched the business with a small Woodmizer band mill to supply beams and lumber for the growing demand for southwestern-style homes in Santa Fe and northern New Mexico.

The sawmill produces natural, custom wood products from locally sourced softwood species — Ponderosa pine, white fir, Douglas fir, and Engelmann spruce. Using a larger Woodmizer thin-kerf band mill and additional equipment, the operation cuts beams, dimensional lumber, and custom profiles. The thin-kerf blade reduces waste and yields up to 30 percent more lumber per log compared with traditional circle saws. All material is harvested by independent local loggers and processed without added chemicals.

Customers include contractors, private homebuilders, and the general public throughout northern New Mexico. The company’s products are used primarily in residential construction and custom home projects that emphasize regional architectural styles.

Lindsey started Spotted Owl to meet a specific regional need for locally milled, natural wood suited to southwestern designs. The company highlights its sustainable sourcing, thin-kerf efficiency, and chemical-free processing as key differentiators.
